P.name: Goes Where He Pleases
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|0.4; then +0.05*x for 5; then +0.1*x for 6; then +0.15*x for 3; then +0.2*x|formula=0.4% + 0.05% per level at level 1, then + 0.1% per level starting at level 7, then + 0.15% per level starting at level 13, then + 0.2% per level starting at level 16|key=%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{pp|0.4/10 to 0.65/10 for 6;0.75/10 to 1.25/10 for 6;1.4/10;1.55/10;1.7/10;1.9/10;2.1/10;2.3/10|key=%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
P.description2: {{sbc|Passive:}} Periodically, '''Dr. Mundo''' gains immunity to the next hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, '''Dr. Mundo''' pays a {{as|health cost}} equal to {{as|4% of his '''current''' health}} and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.
P.description3: '''Dr. Mundo''' can move near the canister to consume it, {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for {{as|4% of his '''maximum''' health}} and reducing the {{sti|cooldown}} of ''Goes Where He Pleases'' by 15 seconds. Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can move near it to destroy it.
P.description4: ''Goes Where He Pleases' '' cooldown resets upon [[respawn|respawning]].
P.static: {{pp|60 to 15 for 6|1;3 to 15 for 5|formula=60 at level 1, then -9 every 3 levels, starting at level 3 and capped at level 15}}

Q.name: Infected Bonesaw
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Infected Bonesaw'' has a minimum damage threshold, and is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description3: If the bonesaw hits an enemy, '''Dr. Mundo''' {{tip|heals}} for 50% of the {{as|health cost}}, increased to 100% against {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Heart Zapper
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' charges up a defibrillator for up to 3 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to nearby enemies and storing {{pplevel|80 to 95|key=%}} of {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], reduced to 25% after the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|5 to 20}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|5*16 to 20*16}}}}
W.description2: ''Heart Zapper'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' detonates the defibrillator, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|healing}} for 50% of [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], increased to 100% if at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} is hit.

E.name: Blunt Force Trauma
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''Dr. Mundo's missing''' health|0 to {{#expr:1.4*100-100}} for 11|0 to 70|formula=0.57% per missing health %, up to a cap of 70%.|color=health}}. If the target dies or is a small monster, they are sent flying away in a line, though not through terrain, causing all enemies they pass through to take {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} plus ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' minimum '''bonus''' damage.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 45}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
E.description3: ''Blunt Force Trauma'' as well as the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} is increased to {{#expr:1.4*100}}% against {{tip|minions}} and {{#expr:1.4*100}}% against {{tip|monsters}}.
E.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Minion Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Minion Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4*1.4 to 45*1.4*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Monster Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Monster Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4*1.4 to 45*1.4*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
E.description4: ''Blunt Force Trauma {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Dr. Mundo's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Maximum Dosage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' injects himself with chemicals to become enhanced for 10 seconds, gaining increased {{sti|health|{{as|'''base''' health}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health regeneration}}}}.
R.description2: At rank 3, ''Maximum Dosage's'' increased {{as|'''base''' health}} and {{as|'''bonus''' health regeneration}} are both increased by 5% for each enemy {{tip|champion}} within 1200 units at the time of cast.
